title: Deploy a medical privacy screen across the treatment bay
instruction: Set the privacy screen so the marked treatment area is screened from the open doorway. Leave it standing securely, then let go.
context: A free-standing folding screen can provide visual privacy during changing or personal care. Position the articulated screen to block a treatment-area target from three specified doorway viewpoints, then release it while it remains supported. This evaluates sampled optical shielding and stable placement; no patient or clinical safety outcome is simulated.
setup: One fixed layout, world x/y horizontal and z up; positions are metres and dimensions below are millimetres. Three freely standing rigid panels each have a nominal 560-wide x 1652-high frame: two 30 x 20 x 2-wall aluminium vertical tubes, each 1622 long; two 500 x 20 x 30 horizontal aluminium tubes with 2-wall thickness; one opaque 500 x 3 x 1542 rigid PVC-foam inlay; and two 32 x 24 x 30 rubber-equivalent floor protectors. The feet make each complete panel's maximum local width 562. Each panel has mass 3.3156072 kg; the linked screen totals 9.9468216 kg. Initial authored panel origins/yaws are centre (0.95,-0.28,0),90 degrees; left (0.965,-0.295,0),180 degrees; right (0.935,0.295,0),180 degrees. Two passive vertical hinge constraints connect the wings to the centre at world (0.965,-0.28,0) and (0.935,0.28,0); their local anchors and limits are in README. Gravity settling puts all six foot bottoms on the actual floor top z=-0.0125. Two independent fixed steel-equivalent pedestals, each 140 x 140 x 750, have bottom-centre positions (0.15,0.55,0) and (0.15,-0.55,0), supporting unmodified parallel-gripper YAM bases at z0.75, 1.10 m apart. The station table is absent. A fixed opaque PVC target board is 8 x 1040 x 940 at centre (1.50,0,1.05); 189 dark 1 x 6 x 6 PVC dots have centres x1.495, y=-0.50 to0.50 every0.05 and z=0.60 to1.50 every0.1125. Three sight-coordinate positions are (0,-0.30,1.10), (0,0,1.10), (0,0.30,1.10). No person, extra tool or loose object is present. README and BOM.csv list materials, construction, poses and the standard ground/camera context. The native setup overview is included in media/setup-two-views.png; individual feet may be occluded. The simulator does not render a doorway or sight marks. Use the listed coordinates and assembly floor template for physical placement. The initial screen is U-shaped and partly deployed: native overall footprint592 x614mm, height1652mm, with85.7143% of target samples already blocked. It is not the manufacturer's605 x82mm compact folded state.
scoring: Observable scoring rule: use the final 21 consecutive fresh observations at canonical20Hz, t0 through t0+1.000s. At every sample, count the567 segments from the three sight positions to the189 target dot centres that intersect finite opaque screen solids before the dot. Award1.0 only if at least562 segments are blocked at every sample (coverage>=99%); award0.5 if at least397 are blocked at every sample (coverage>=70%) and the full tier is not met. Both tiers require, at all21 samples in that same window: each panel upright within5degrees; all six foot bottoms within+/-5mm of the actual floor top; both hinge anchor gaps<=5mm; and minimum finite-solid Euclidean screen-to-robot clearance>=50mm over all630 current robot collision hulls. Each panel body origin must stay within5mm of its first-sample origin, and its SO(3) shortest orientation change from its first-sample orientation must stay<=1degree at every sample. Native instantaneous linear/angular speed magnitudes are not score criteria; all required poses, native velocity records, timestamps and geometry must still be finite and valid. Missing, duplicate, stale, nonfinite or unresolved geometric evidence cannot establish credit: report an invalid/indeterminate assessment with no certified score, separately from an established physical violation. Valid outcomes satisfying neither tier score0. Physical checks use PRIMARY-HUMAN-SCORING.md and PHYSICAL-PROTOCOL.md with measured uncertainty; they do not change task thresholds. Finite sampling establishes these sampled conditions only. No prescribed135degree arrangement, hand assignment or reference phase is required. The quiet initial U-shaped layout may earn0.5 if all conditions hold; it is not full credit.
run_limit: 1,200 control steps:60 simulated seconds at20Hz control and960Hz physics. The final21-sample,1-second acceptance window must finish within the action limit. Measured wrapper wall time including startup/reset: scripted demo1,026.556s for824 controls; Dream-1 run1,517.820s for1,200 controls. External timeouts do not add robot actions.
reset_notes: Start a fresh episode with both stock arms READY and grippers open, restore the three panel origins/yaws and all fixed objects above, then allow the normal recorded gravity settle onto the actual floor. All temporary human support must be released before actions. No in-trial pose reset, attachment or hidden locking is used. Nothing is consumed. In a real layout use the same panel and sight-mark floor templates, verify free hinges and six supported feet, and recheck the target board and arm-base positions.
fidelity: Original full-size engineering-equivalent construction in the AGA PV-3003 dimensional/material class, not OEM CAD or measured dynamics. The manufacturer lists1652 mm height and11.6 kg; this source explicitly constructs three nominal560 mm panels at9.9468216 kg. Aluminium2700, rigid PVC foam500, rubber1100 and steel7850 kg/m3 are declared density assumptions. All panel walls/inlays/feet are finite rigid convex collision solids; two passive native vertical hinges with adjacent-panel collision enabled and native ground contact allow sliding and tipping. Rubber feet are rigid friction equivalents; PVC flexibility, hinge-pin detail and calibrated hinge/floor forces are absent. Hinge stiffness is0, damping0.08 N m s/rad; stock robot PD/effort/gripper limits remain unchanged. Coverage uses actual opaque solids and leaves hinge air gaps open. The board represents the treatment sightline target; no patient or clinical care is simulated. No controller writes task-body poses, velocities, external forces or temporary grasp attachments. A proposed original build drawing uses two short coaxial hinges per joint; hardware mass and finite knuckle geometry are omitted by the ideal joint, not asserted to be included or OEM-calibrated. The score uses the 21-sample panel-origin/SO(3) envelope and requires finite-convex Euclidean clearance over all630 current robot collision hulls. Native velocity records remain subject to finite-data safety checks. This establishes sampled conditions, without establishing continuous-time stability or clearance. PRIMARY-HUMAN-SCORING.md gives the primary proposed physical procedure: direct photographs from the three fixed viewpoints, rulers, a level and ordinary5mm/50mm gauges with uncertainty bounds. It does not require reconstructing robot meshes or forward kinematics; the630 hulls are the simulation representation. These are proposed measurement procedures; no calibrated real-world accuracy, physical trial or sim-real agreement has yet been established.
scores: Dream-1 beta: 0.5 (seed1, full1,200 controls/60 simulated seconds; independent final scoring agrees). Scripted demo:1.0 (seed1,824 controls/41.2 simulated seconds; independent final21-sample audit passed). The quiet initial layout also earns0.5, so this model result does not demonstrate improved shielding.
